# decisions

Locked decisions, append-only. Reference by D-ID (`D-001`, `D-002`, …) elsewhere in the codebase and other docs.

Each entry:

```
## D-NNN — short title
**Date:** YYYY-MM-DD
**Status:** locked | superseded by D-NNN
**Context:** what triggered the decision (1–3 sentences)
**Decision:** what we chose (1 sentence)
**Reversibility:** reversible-cheap | expensive-to-undo
**Routed via:** which agent(s) proposed/reviewed; tech-lead synthesized; ceo signed off
```
